starting_character_area_or_context: Industrial Employment or established Atlanta Highway / Thurmon Tanner / Falcon Parkway industrial corridor
target_zoning_or_use: Office warehouse light manufacturing warehouse variance or site-plan execution
customer_read: Best customer starting point inside city limits because the question is usually site constraints not whether industrial belongs there
case_examples: 4627 Atlanta Highway Business Park existing M-1 with office/warehouse variance
conditions_or_friction: Stream buffer impervious setback parking stormwater and construction permits still control execution
acquisition_rule: Prioritize M-1 sites where building scale access and utilities already match the target product

starting_zoning_or_status: Highway Business or commercial frontage already planned for industrial-employment transition
starting_character_area_or_context: Industrial Employment / I-985 interchange logistics context
customer_read: Strong conversion lane when frontage is at Exit 12/14 or Thurmon Tanner and the city can keep commercial frontage where appropriate
case_examples: Exit 12 / Hines HB-to-M-1; Thurmon Tanner Logistics
conditions_or_friction: Traffic contribution development agreement buffers detention residential interface and parcel-to-building phasing
acquisition_rule: Commercial frontage can become industrial when the city can preserve road function and buffer neighbors

starting_zoning_or_status: Agricultural land inside the city or annexed into a proven industrial corridor
starting_character_area_or_context: Activity Center or Industrial Employment context with major infrastructure story
target_zoning_or_use: M-1 industrial park warehouse or office-warehouse
customer_read: Convertible when the project expands an existing industrial corridor and solves sewer road and cross-jurisdiction infrastructure
case_examples: Project Falcon A-to-M-1 Flowery Branch portion
conditions_or_friction: Large sewer/pump-station DOT utility easement and multi-jurisdiction coordination can be more important than zoning label
acquisition_rule: Good land-control candidate only if the infrastructure plan is real and sponsor can carry timing risk

starting_zoning_or_status: Hall County Light Industrial or similar industrial edge annexed into the city
starting_character_area_or_context: City industrial corridor context but not necessarily freight/logistics use
target_zoning_or_use: City M-1 plus CUP or conditions
customer_read: Good procedural comp for annexation and M-1 mechanics but not automatically a warehouse/truck precedent
case_examples: 4272 Thurmon Tanner Hall County Light Industrial to City M-1 plus CUP
conditions_or_friction: Use-specific conditions may limit transferability to freight industrial; later operating status still matters
acquisition_rule: Use as annexation/M-1 process evidence and separately test freight/logistics fit

starting_zoning_or_status: Hall County agricultural or rural district annexed to City M-2
starting_character_area_or_context: Industrial Employment may support heavy industry but neighborhood and environmental fit are decisive
target_zoning_or_use: M-2 quarry heavy manufacturing extractive or nuisance-potential industrial use
customer_read: Possible but high-scrutiny and not comparable to ordinary warehouse/logistics
case_examples: In-town Vulcan Lands AR III to M-2 plus CUP quarry approval
conditions_or_friction: State permits blasting truck traffic creek/tree impacts berms screening and neighborhood response drive feasibility
acquisition_rule: Underwrite as a special heavy-industrial thesis with longer schedule and higher community-risk budget

starting_zoning_or_status: Existing M-1 site needing material relief from buffers setbacks or site constraints
starting_character_area_or_context: Industrial corridor but physically constrained parcel
target_zoning_or_use: Office warehouse or light industrial with variance relief
customer_read: Viable for smaller flex/office-warehouse product when the city can condition relief
case_examples: 4627 Atlanta Highway stream-buffer and impervious-setback variances
conditions_or_friction: Variance risk is lower than full rezoning but construction permits and stormwater still matter
acquisition_rule: Good infill strategy if the customer can live with smaller buildings and constrained site design

starting_zoning_or_status: Marketed or under-construction industrial project without a confirmed Flowery Branch city-limit entitlement chain
starting_character_area_or_context: Potentially Hall/Oakwood/Flowery edge but city jurisdiction not established
target_zoning_or_use: Do not rely on as Flowery Branch conversion precedent
customer_read: Useful as I-985 market demand evidence but not as a city-limit zoning template
case_examples: Alliance 985; Pattillo as market/status comp where historic city zoning chain is incomplete
conditions_or_friction: Jurisdiction parcel chain permit route and city/county authority must be confirmed before using as comp
acquisition_rule: Treat as market support only until the exact city-limit approval path is matched

starting_zoning_or_status: Residential neighborhood commercial downtown mixed-use or non-industrial civic character context
starting_character_area_or_context: Non-industrial character area or corridor without industrial fabric
customer_read: Weak customer target inside Flowery Branch city limits because the city code ties M-1/M-2 to Industrial Employment and road-network fit
case_examples: No positive city-limit warehouse conversion comp in the reviewed cases
conditions_or_friction: Plan mismatch neighborhood interface local-road truck impacts and political friction dominate
acquisition_rule: Avoid unless a specific comprehensive-plan change and infrastructure package are already in motion
